meta.dataset: World Bank WDI using IMF Balance of Payments Statistics (BPM6), Net financial account
meta.method: Financial account net = net acquisition of foreign financial assets minus net incurrence of liabilities (BPM6). Positive = net lender to rest of world (capital exporter); Negative = net borrower (capital importer). Net is NOT gross bilateral cash transfers. FDI and portfolio shown as separate breakdown indicators and are not individually equivalent to gross inflows and outflows.
meta.limitations: WDI IMF BoP sample where country rows report. No country-to-country transaction destinations; data not equivalent to BIS/IMF positions; some 2025 economies missing; reserve transactions are included in financial account. Years must be compared separately.
